# Jaime Chapinal

> Jaime Chapinal is a Senior Software Engineer at Spotify, working on web and desktop experiences and developer tooling. Previously at Amazon, King, and Electronic Arts.

Career: experience in web, desktop, games, developer tools, and client quality platforms. Languages: Spanish (native), English (full professional), Swedish (basic).

Recognition: Nova 111 List winner (2024), Electronic Arts Superstar Award (2016), Global Game Jam Madrid BeatJamp award (2013); co-author of "Natural interaction techniques using Kinect" (Interacción 2012).

Personal projects outside his role at Spotify: Chapiware builds calm, local-first apps for memories, habits, reading, and personal data. No account, cloud, or tracking is required for its products.

## Work

- [Spotify](https://jaimechapinal.com/work/spotify.html): Web and desktop features, and Client Quality Platform tooling
- [Kindle](https://jaimechapinal.com/work/kindle.html): The Kindle web reader and the Kindle Reader apps for PC and Mac
- [Candy Crush Saga](https://jaimechapinal.com/work/candy-crush.html): Gameplay features and production tools at King

## Projects and writing

- [Chapiware](https://www.chapiware.com/): Independent, local-first apps
- [Ayer](https://www.chapiware.com/ayer/): Photos and videos taken on today's date in previous years, kept on the phone
